text: P174059 - Kenya GPE COVID-19 Learning Continuity in Basic Education Project (closed). Seven matching public records, oldest first by document date:
7. 2022-06-22 - Implementation Completion and Results Report (ICR5949), disclosed 2022-07-12. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099245007082214737
All three requested types are available. The project's other public records (ISRs, ESCPs, an ICR Review, audits) were not requested.

right_sources: Filters by project ID P174059 and the three document types; returns the PAD, all five procurement plans and the ICR.
grounded: Dates, report numbers and links match the records; nothing is added that the project does not have.
complete: All seven records, in ascending document-date order, with a link each.
scoped: Orders by document date (and does not confuse it with disclosure date, e.g. the PAD was disclosed 2021-04-01); says whether each requested type was found.
